silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A signed contract is effectively used for its full coverage period, with no separate partial-usage rule needed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether a contract must be kept for its entire term; the summary models coverage only through monthly balance equations.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved and was silently omitted.

summary: The agent resolved the core P0 objective and exact-demand slots, but missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and the P2 contract-count and full-coverage details, then stopped with those hidden facts silently assumed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
